proposal.split: unlabeled clean multi-session training disjoint from evaluation by recording/image hash
proposal.selection: fixed nested subsets; count recordings/viewpoints separately; no GT-based pseudo-label selection
proposal.inference: same frozen detector; refiner only; last checkpoint; no E6 student self-training
proposal.analysis: within-size A11-like vs A10-like direct contrast plus normal/source preservation, no best-of-6 deployment
proposal.if_insufficient_sessions: stop preparation and request dataset choice; do not duplicate adjacent frames to claim diversity
